_note: PUT this to /v2/acts/{actorId} as a pricingInfos array entry. PAY_PER_EVENT only on BRONZE. startedAt must be 14+ days out. Apify auto-adds 20% margin. listing.eventDescription: One Shopify app with name, developer, rating, reviews, and pricing, but no public support email or company website.

lead.eventDescription: A Shopify app with a public developer support email or a company website, plus rating, reviews, and pricing.

qualified_lead.eventDescription: An app with a public support email and reviews at or above the qualified bar. A reachable, established developer. The first 10 qualified_lead per run are free so you can validate output.
